## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 3 sept 2026 - 3 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Jose Maria Araque_, 3 sept 2026, 1/5: "The app was good before, I paid for the single-time ad free version. Despite that they now blocked certain features that were free before behind a monthly paywall. Reply: yes, some exercises I was using in the past for free are now behind the subscription. I changed my phone and this features cant be transfert to the new one."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 20 jul 2026 - 12 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Evan Metcalfe_, 12 ago 2026, 1/5: "This app was awesome, so much so that you didn't even mind the couple of ads it had because that meant the app was free. Buy some update must have happened because now I get the same ad for some other fitness app and even though there is a close button, no matter how many times I press it or wait or close and reopen the app, the ad does not close so this app is now completely unusable for me. I cannot even provide feedback in app as the ads start immediately on opening the app"
            2. _Joshua johnston_, 20 jul 2026, 4/5: "the ads generated in the app will freeze the app itself. other than that the app is phenomenal. I do wish there were a few more unlocked exercises, but as a free app there's nothing missing. logging and generating exercise plans are great and the fact that I can regenerate a single exercise or all of them. 4.2/5"
<!--/ir-theme-->
